title: The Intake Processing Chamber

features.name: the processing window
features.desc-on-touch: A counter where arrival is officially recognized. Everything you bring is examined, catalogued, filed into the permanent record of having arrived.

features.name: the file-stack
features.desc-on-touch: Forms stacked as high as the eye can follow. Each one requires a signature, a date, a reason. Arrival has bureaucracy now.

features.name: the holding-grid
features.desc-on-touch: A chamber divided into squares. Each square holds someone in the process of arriving. They wait. Waiting is part of arrival now.

features.name: the entry-seal
features.desc-on-touch: A stamp that makes arrival official. Once stamped, you cannot be un-arrived. The archive now has a record of you. Arrival is permanent.

features.name: the waiting-bench
features.desc-on-touch: A place to sit while processing. Others have sat here. Their wear-marks are still in the wood. Arrival takes time. Everyone learns this the same way.

inscription: the gate became an office; arrival became a process; nothing leaves because it is still being filed, still being processed, still being officially recognized

file.name: Intake_Log_Arrivals_Alphabetical_By_Certainty.txt
file.note: Registry of everyone processed through this chamber. Each entry notes how long they waited, which form they signed, whether they accepted the permanent record of having arrived.

exits.label: back through the gate to the place where nothing left
toward the deeper chambers where processing continues forever
upward to the archive records that hold all arrivals
down to the ledger-floor where every arrival is written
